recent_posts.title: Abacus AI Review 2026: ChatLLM, DeepAgent & Pricing Guide
recent_posts.summary: Abacus AI is an AI platform combining ChatLLM (a multi-model conversational workspace for writing, coding, image/video generation, and research) and DeepAgent (an agentic layer for multi-step tasks like dashboards, automations, and app builds). Pricing starts at $10/user/month on a credit-based system. The platform targets teams looking to consolidate multiple AI subscriptions into one. ChatLLM suits everyday prompting and quick tasks, while DeepAgent handles complex, multi-step workflows. Key strengths include cost efficiency, model variety, and broad feature coverage; limitations include credit consumption for heavy media/agent use and the need for thoughtful prompting on complex tasks.

recent_posts.title: AI-Powered Marketing Compliance Review
recent_posts.summary: A marketing compliance review system uses RAG-powered AI workflows to automatically classify marketing content using a traffic light system (red/yellow/green). Built on 181 pages of compliance documentation, the system leverages Claude V3.7 Sonnet to analyze content against regulatory guidelines for the beverage alcohol industry. It provides instant compliance analysis with detailed explanations, source citations, and actionable recommendations. The solution achieved 90%+ reduction in review time and 70%+ reduction in legal team workload by handling first-pass reviews and flagging only complex cases for human review.

recent_posts.title: Sharper LLMs: Enhancing Math and Reasoning Abilities
recent_posts.summary: A new model has been released to enhance the mathematical and reasoning capabilities of LLMs, specifically targeting the improvement of GSM8K scores. The model achieves a nearly 13% increase in GSM8K score and an overall improvement of about 1% on average.

recent_posts.title: How to Soup up your Open Source LLM
recent_posts.summary: Open source LLMs have been improving in performance and can be customized for different use cases. The quality of training data is crucial, and the MetaMath dataset addresses weaknesses in math and reasoning. Stacking and merging techniques can be used to create new models without training, resulting in significant improvements.

recent_posts.title: Abacus.AI at NeurIPS 2023
recent_posts.summary: The Abacus.AI team has published five papers at NeurIPS 2023, including one awarded with an Oral Presentation. They cover topics such as zero-shot forecasting, bias mitigation in face recognition, neural networks vs. boosted trees on tabular data, and improving fairness and accuracy in tabular data models.

recent_posts.title: Open Source LLMs, Fine-Tunes and RAG Based Vector Store APIs
recent_posts.summary: Organizations can infuse LLMs into their planning and decision making processes by utilizing open source LLMs APIs, fine-tuned models, and a vector store API for RAG. These options provide cost-effective alternatives to closed models and allow for customization and scalability.

recent_posts.title: Machine Learning Meets Optimization
recent_posts.summary: Combining forecasting and optimization can streamline the achievement of business objectives. However, teams face challenges when trying to incorporate optimization solutions.

recent_posts.title: Closing the Gap to Closed Source LLMs
recent_posts.summary: The Abacus release a larger 70B version of Giraffe, succeeding the 13B model we mentioned in a previous blog post. Giraffe is a family of models that are finetuned from base Llama 2 and use context length extension techniques to increase their effective context length capability from 4096 to approximately 32,000.

recent_posts.title: Supercharge Productivity: Accomplish 10X more with AI Agents
recent_posts.summary: AIs AI Agents provides users a platform to build AI Agents that can solve tasks with human-like abilities or even better. Abacus offers a range of LLM options, including GPT3.5, GPT4, Palm, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Llama2, as well as Abacus custom models.

recent_posts.title: Data LLM: Get insights from your data
recent_posts.summary: AI’s Data LLM Agent provides this as a packaged solution for querying data warehouses. Abacus offers Bots for business communication platforms like Teams and Slack. Abacus also provides an API endpoint that you can use to power any app.
